reviews.title: I wish for a little more
reviews.text:
I’ve been a user for some time and I feel like there’s some good changes and some bad ones. 
The good is that the general playthrough is good doesn’t railroad you much, but I have encountered certain times where in a characters background I described a feature or ability he will soon have in his background and note for the AI to know it’s not some made up thing. After it’s been done and completed through the quests the AI will draw upon it and think it’s still an ongoing story thread when it was already resolved through the quests tab. But other than that the way the AI builds the world is good and allows for you to get lost in it. 
The bad is I feel like if you’re doing an adventure based off a series in real life like let’s say Dragon Ball or Naruto or other anime’s. I find the AI doesn’t seem to handle personalities very well they act like themselves at first obviously but later down the line in game years later could pass by and they’re still the same way as they were first presented there’s no nuance to them they act the same I have to constantly remind it the time period and where the characters are at mentally even when it’s written down in the adventure log. Another thing with the characters is that they seem to always spew wisdom at me and coming from someone who isn’t wise in the show really kills it for me. I’m not sure if it’s a AI model thing or limitation that it can’t draw upon current lore because it also seems to make things up as it goes if I’m trying to go more lore accurate. Then finally the romance in this game feels very generic and boring like it’s pretty watered down in my opinion I don’t really like the half measure of it when before it was much more open or liberal about that sort of thing but now it seems pretty neutered so I’d say romance is  okay not the best for what it is and there’s better apps if you want more romance or less censorship if you’re into that you probably won’t find it here. Another  thing the memory isn’t great so you will need to figure out how to word things concisely to put into the adventure log for the AI to remember it sucks you can’t go into detail, the character creation is also I feel pretty lackluster like you tell it how you want your character to look like and their personality so by the time you’re let’s say 15 turns in and you ask the AI to confirm what you’re character looks like and is like it will give you something completely different. Finally the character limits on character backgrounds, titles, classes is just in general bad because if you want a detailed background the AI can do it and give you a background above the character limit but if you continue to customize your character the AI will undoubtedly alter your background slightly until it’s not what you thought it was same thing with the character portrait creation. 
All in all it’s a 3 star because the world building is amazing and carries this app heavily I find but also the negatives are minute to where they’re pretty much more like annoyances there’s probably more negatives here in this review but it’s not game breaking just annoying or at rare times not worth playing for a while.

reviews.title: Good role play and character development, poor healing, no tokens after purchasing subscription
reviews.text:
A good, fun game. Combats can become repetitive, but also can be narrated into non-combat encounters. 

Biggest issue with play is with healing. You use a healing mechanic and the game reports successful healing, but the character do not regain any lost hp and the health bar does not recover either. Had 1 character die after three encounters with no hp recovery despite multiple narrated complete healings and “full health” statuses. 

Bug report sent, took a few days, but healing improved for a couple weeks, I now ensure that all characters have multiple ways to heal themselves and each other.

GM ALWAYS attacks the weakest character (this is usually the PC, but not always). The only exception is if you narrate a new or upgrade to a previous skill, it will tailor make an enemy to have you “try out the new skill(s) and either invalidate or make largely ineffective other skills or characters. 

New Issue: I payed for a subscription and got an immediate token boost (as expected) that was over 6 weeks ago and the monthly allotment has never been given to me. Support is still silent on the issue.

reviews.title: The game steals from you.
reviews.text:
It runs on a token system, fair enough.  

One token for one turn.  But what if the game is unclear and you aren’t sure what it meant, (which happens more often than it should)?

The answer is:  The question to clarify the situation you ALREADY PAID FOR costs you ANOTHER token.

Also, they advertise 5 tokens every 4 hours, but that is only if you log in every 4 hours to collect them.  They do not build up over time past these 5 tokens, it’s misleading the way they present it.

My only problem is that I’m extremely strong now, but I’m also fighting extremely strong enemies and I’d like to level up faster. I’m level 10. But I keep getting quests that tell me they’re going to be worth like 1000 XP but then once I get the quest in my quest book and completed it’s only worth 120 XP plus a special ability that says I surge with power that increases my experience by 1000 and I would just actually like the XP instead of the game lying to me

reviews.title: Almost perfect
reviews.text: This game is by far the best AI adventure game with great subscriptions and no cash grabbing, it allows infinite adventure potential and the ability to create your own adventures, it’s inventory and leveling system is spot on, sidequesting and Ai to GM communication is wonderful, the only two issues that stop this game from being a perfect 5 star is the online play being super tedious due to a bug where one player has to close the app or window while another player takes their turn making online play practically unplayable, Local play is amazing but all characters made are essential locked into that one story as you cannot select saved champions in online or local play which is super disappointing like why would I work so hard to get my solo character leveled if I can’t even use them to play with my friends, other than those two problems the game would be perfect in my book and it’s replay ability infinite. Overall game is amazing and I hope they get everything sorted for QOL multiplayer because even friends who aren’t really into this have gotten into it even my wife and that’s something!

reviews.text:
This is actually worth it. They do T1 combat understand of traditional DnD. You can genuinely control the flow of battle based on how you steer your character. 

For example I have an eldritch insignia on my hand that glows a white flame hotter than white phosphorus. The game took that with stride and even let me freestyle with this ability but they never let me just win or cheat. Worth a shot.

reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text:
I thought I’d give it a try for a DND setup, it started off fine, new adventure made. I described curse of strahd with my character, including how I was going to start with gear.

The app then immediately forgot my character and background, put me in a town of strahd, and continued to tell me to pick a world design.

Restarting app did not help. AI just seemed confused.

reviews.title: Enjoyable and Creative
reviews.text: I’m finding this a fun way to spark creativity and storytelling. However, I don’t like how very repetitive the game is as you continue on along the same storyline. With each goal completed, every subsequent sequal is essentially the same story, repeated, with the same beats, same basic goal, same enemies, just all with slightly different names. This makes me less inclined to keep playing. I want storylines that evolve and grow instead of just repeating themselves. We need variety in the storytelling to make this really worthwhile.
